name: Circular-check floor
section: Finishing rungs — what stands between "stopped talking" and "delivered"
prose: the floor's second shape, for the turn that DID run something where what it ran leans on a stand-in the same turn wrote (mock/fake/stub/patch, matched on high-precision markers in the written text only, never in the file already on disk). One reminder that a double agrees with whatever its author believed and so proves nothing about the dependency it replaced: name where each contract came from, confirm it from the dependency itself, and fix both sides if they disagree. Its own once-per-turn fuse; the two shapes disagree on whether a command ran, so only one can fire at a given stop.
invariant: When the turn's checking leaned on self-written stand-ins, the reminder says a passing check against your own mock proves only self-consistency.
